migrations.postcondition: state remains valid JSON; existing top-level fields preserved except story_craft is replaced when absent or malformed; not lossless for malformed nested values.
migrations.ambiguity_handling: Backup exists, but nested malformed value is not reported before replacement; do not treat as a lossless Story System migration.
migrations.retirement_criterion: A preflight/reporting mode and preservation behavior are tested, or all supported callers leave old shape and the migration support window closes after reviewed evidence.
